senses.definition: a usually soluble substance for staining or coloring e.g. fabrics or hair

examples: The laboratory worker dyed the specimen

senses.definition: (used of verbs (e.g. ‘to run’) and participial adjectives (e.g. ‘running’ in ‘running water’)) expressing action rather than a state of being
characterized by action or forcefulness or force of personality
examples: the dynamic president of the firm
they hoped it would act as a spiritual dynamic on all churches

senses.definition: a sequence of powerful leaders in the same family
